reviewed_by: Claude Code after independent subagent root-cause validation and scratch-Core reproduction
reason: Memory admission charged a SIGKILLed project worker's execution reserve until recovery retired it, so on the default Core reserve (services + API + two workers) recovery of a dead worker could never admit its replacement. Admission now skips incarnations the process host proves ended (same launch namespace and boot, kernel no longer reports the PID birth). Selected: the runtime memory suite, with the new dead-incarnation admission test, the host proof test and the supervisor binding check.
exclusions: No UI, native or Playwright layer: no operator-visible interface change. Scratch-Core reproduction (STUCK on main, PASS on the branch) is recorded in the PR.
